mutableInputCorrection.fix: Snapshot the factory model/run/fallback selection together with the credential. Snapshot messages, tools and scalar request fields before quota/reservation waits, retaining the actual cancellation signal.
mutableInputCorrection.verification: Actual factory, quota/reservation/settlement protocol fixtures and SDK interception preserve original owner, selected provider, key and project text despite route and in-wait payload mutations. No live provider request or real database accounting is claimed.
mutableInputCorrection.remaining: New scoped callers carry issued context, current project/account/vault revision, wire payload and canonical budget/run binding. Unmigrated generic callers and complete upstream file/history provenance remain pending. Controlled protocol fixtures are not real database concurrency or provider acceptance.

Controlled protocol fixtures are not real database budget receipts.
